background:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact fantasy game overview. Keep the exact original composition, aspect ratio, framing, every border and ornament position, gold materials, sapphire gems, lanterns, fox portrait and module pictures absolutely unchanged.
Remove only these four baked padlocks and their circular backplates: the large padlock on the catacomb door at left, and the three small round padlock badges at the right end of the three horizontal navy module panels. Restore believable carved door artwork behind the large lock and perfectly continuous dark navy enamel behind the three badge locations. icons:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 2 by 2 isolated UI icon atlas for the supplied fantasy-game reference. Match its dimensional hand-painted polished warm gold, midnight navy enamel and luminous cyan sapphires exactly. Asset layers only, no whole page.
Canvas square with four exactly equal square cells. TOP ROW: the round gold PAW MEDALLION from the reference, normal on the left, identical active on the right. A large unmistakable raised gold paw with four toe pads, navy disk inside sculpted golden rim. Active changes only soft cyan jewel light and restrained edge highlights, never geometry.
BOTTOM ROW: a friendly magical AMULET, normal at left, identical active at right. A short clearly visible loop of gold necklace chain at the top attaches to a large round pendant, thick sculpted gold rim, one tiny sapphire above the round center. The pendant's central circular face is PLAIN DARK NAVY and intentionally EMPTY to receive one large runtime numeral. It must read as a necklace, not a padlock, not a medal on a ribbon, not an abstract line. The empty central face is at least 38% of the cell width. Active only changes light, with a few compact cyan sparkles. Keep chain, circle and jewel identical between states.
All four objects centered in their own equal square cell with generous transparent margin, no overlap, complete uncut silhouettes. Identical silhouette, pose, scale, cell size and placement within each normal/active pair. Do not generate lettering, labels, numerals, interface frames, controls or scenery. Children cannot rely on reading: the paw and necklace must be instantly recognizable. Stable artwork layers composed later with runtime text, layout and code animation. Genuine transparent background, no checkerboard painted into image, no cast shadows on background.
